set.body: Add graph-linalg depending only on graph and linalg. Reuse LinearMap, SparseTriplets, and CsrMatrix. Provide VertexOperator, VertexSignal, EdgeBasis, topologyAdjacency, weightedAdjacency, degree versus strength, deterministic incidence orientation, combinatorial and normalized Laplacians, explicit weighted-zero/isolate policies, and shared algebraic tests.
set.title: Graph-linalg: basis-carrying adjacency, incidence, strength, and Laplacian operators
